description: Master aggregation of all %%semantic{...}%% blocks from obsidian-epistemic-tagger plugin

semantic_format.description: The obsidian-epistemic-tagger plugin uses hidden comment blocks to store classification metadata
semantic_format.visibility: Hidden in Reading Mode, visible in Edit/Source Mode

evidence.description: Empirical data, experimental results, observations that support or refute claims
examples: Global Consciousness Project data shows p < 10⁻⁷
Quantum Zeno effect measured by Itano et al.

assumption.description: Premises taken as true without proof, foundational beliefs
examples: Consciousness is fundamental rather than emergent

claim.description: Assertions made that require evidence or argument
examples: The Logos Field unifies GR and QM
Christianity uniquely satisfies all 8 boundary conditions

how_it_works: 4. Plugin appends classification to %%semantic{...}%% block at end of file
6. This master sheet aggregates ALL such blocks across vault
scanner_behavior: Aggregates classifications by type, file, confidence

instructions: This master sheet will populate automatically once notes are classified using the obsidian-epistemic-tagger plugin. To classify text: 1) Select text in Obsidian, 2) Right-click → Classify As, 3) Choose type (evidence/assumption/claim/theory/method). Run 'python theophysics_axiom_builder.py --scan-semantic' to refresh this sheet.
